changelog.body:
- **Languages & Patch List:**
  * Fixed patch names and descriptions still showing in English when NexFusion's in-app language is set to Chinese.

- **Languages & Patch List:**
  * Patch names and descriptions now appear in your device language when supported by the patch bundle (with English as the fallback), without resetting your saved toggle choices.

- **Launcher & Settings:**
  * Fixed toggling **Hide launcher icon** in Settings closing the app instead of keeping the Settings screen open.

- **Supported Apps:**
  * Removed Telegram and Telegram Web from the built-in supported apps list.

- **Patch Sources & Dialog UI:**
  * Removed the incompatible `2eno NexAlloyNext Patches` preset from the Add Source dialog.
  * Fixed dark, unreadable input text in text fields inside dark-themed dialogs.

- **Startup Performance:**
  * Kept resolved patch lookups cached across bundle updates when the target app has not changed, making app launches noticeably faster after updating bundles.
  * Reduced unnecessary disk writes during app startup.

- **Documentation:**
  * Added a clear usage disclaimer to the repository README.

- **Settings & About:**
  * Added `Telegram Channel` (`t.me/nexfusion`) under the About section in both Miuix and Material 3 Settings layouts.
- **Release CI / Telegram Publishing:**
  * Formatted Telegram release changelogs with `<blockquote expandable>` sections and a full-text `sendMessage` reply fallback when notes exceed the 1024-character media caption limit.

- **Diagnostic & Patcher Logging Improvements:**
  * Forwarded `PatcherLog.state` and `PatcherLog.error` output to `XposedBridge.log` so LSPosed and Vector bug reports always capture app version, cache decisions, applied patches, and failure details on release builds.
  * Logged DexKit fingerprint misses at error level in release builds and replaced bare `!!` assertions on cached lookups with `FingerprintNotFoundException` naming the missing fingerprint.
- **HyperOS & OEM Dual-App Detection:**
  * Added dynamic secondary user discovery via `pm list users` and `pm list packages --user` in `AppDiscovery` so OEM dual-app spaces (such as HyperOS Dual Apps and Samsung Secure Folder) are detected without hardcoded user IDs.

- **Cold-Start UI Fix:**
  * Prevented the Home screen from briefly flashing the "No patch bundles installed" empty state on cold start before the initial bundle refresh completes.

- **Dynamic Dual-App & Multi-Profile Detection:**
  * Added dynamic secondary profile detection via `UserManager` and `LauncherApps` (supporting HyperOS Dual Apps, Work Profiles, Samsung Dual Messenger, and Private Space without hardcoded OEM rules).
  * Surfaced apps installed in secondary profiles on the Home screen with a `Dual` badge on application cards.
- **Automatic Stale Scope Cleanup:**
  * Automatically removes unsupported or excluded applications from LSPosed scope via `XposedService.removeScope`, with a fallback dialog prompting manual removal when needed.
- **Branding & Icon Uniformity:**
  * Updated repository icon assets to match the Android adaptive launcher icon.

- **Android 17 & HyperOS 4 Hardening:**
  * Hardened device-protected storage bundle copies with read-only permissions (`setReadOnly()`).
  * Added `PathClassLoader` fallback when `DexClassLoader` fails to load bundle dex files.
  * Guarded `Application.onCreate` hook lookup and initialization, `ResourcesLoader` asset registration (with `addAssetPath` fallback), and `ClassLoader.parent` injection against runtime exceptions.
- **Release Automation:**
  * Added automatic Telegram channel publishing for release notes and APK assets.

### NexFusion 5.0.4

- **Localization & Multi-Language Support:**
  * Added complete Simplified Chinese (简体中文) translation covering all screens, options, and diagnostics.
  * Introduced an in-app Language selector directly in the Settings top bar (accessible via the universal translation icon).
  * Implemented runtime context wrapping to dynamically switch languages with instant UI reloading without requiring an app restart.
  * Replaced all remaining hardcoded strings across screens with localized string resources.
- **Community Translations:**
  * Added dedicated `TRANSLATIONS.md` guide for open-source community translation contributions.

### NexFusion 5.0.3

- **Performance & Navigation Fluidity:**
  * Cached patch bundle loading in ViewModel to eliminate stutter and hitching when returning from patch details.
  * Enhanced predictive back animation curve and edge swipe responsiveness.
  * Streamlined batch patch toggle actions with instant reactive updates.
- **Ecosystem Synchronization:**
  * Synchronized compatibility series with NexFusion Patches bundle v5.0.2.

### NexFusion 5.0.2

- **Themed Floating Notification Snackbar:**
  * Replaced top-screen notification banners with a unified floating bottom snackbar safely elevated above the navigation bar and window insets.
  * Designed theme-adaptive dark mode surfaces with rounded geometry, subtle borders, and ambient drop shadows, eliminating harsh white top banners in dark mode.
  * Refined snackbar message handling to instantly present new status and error notifications.

### NexFusion 5.0.1

- Fluid Navigation Bar & Tab Transition Optimization:
  * Synchronized floating bottom bar selection with target pager state, eliminating animation hitch and intermediate tab reversal when skipping non-adjacent tabs (e.g., Home to Settings).
  * Enabled pre-composed viewport page caching across top-level screens (beyondViewportPageCount = 2) to ensure 60/120fps stutter-free horizontal swipe transitions.
  * Harmonized pager scroll physics and bottom bar indicator spring trajectories for fluid, unified tab navigation.
- Auto-Update Reliability:
  * Enhanced patch bundle migration routines to seamlessly resolve resource ID collisions across package namespaces.
  * Integrated automatic bundle downloads directly into update check cycles.

### NexFusion 5.0.0

- Modernized package namespace to io.github.a092devs.nexfusion with full backwards compatibility for legacy bundles.
- Decoupled application discovery: targets are detected dynamically from installed patch bundles.
- Added background patch bundle auto-updates with WorkManager.
- Redesigned update notification cards and added horizontal swipe navigation.
- Enhanced landscape layout with adaptive max-width containers and refined FAB positioning.
- Hardened anti-detection Stealth Cloak.

# NexFusion **NexFusion** is an open-source runtime patch manager and LSPosed framework featuring a clean Material You interface. It applies in-memory bytecode hooks dynamically using **libxposed** and **DexKit** to popular Android applications without modifying the original APKs, breaking Play Store signatures, or losing official update paths. --- ## What Makes NexFusion Different? Unlike traditional patching tools that require compiling and repacking modified APKs: - **Zero APK Repacking**: Modifies bytecode purely in RAM at app startup via LSPosed. Original apps stay untouched and can be updated normally through Google Play. - **Modular Patch Bundles (`.nxb`)**: Patches and hooks are distributed as lightweight, independently updatable bundles. Update patch features without reinstalling the manager app. - **Dynamic Target Discovery**: Only targets applications supported by your installed patch bundles—no hardcoded app clutter. - **Automatic Background Updates**: Optionally checks for and installs patch bundle updates in the background for a seamless set-it-and-forget-it experience. - **Built-in Stealth Cloak**: Shields target apps from detecting root or Xposed module presence. --- ## Supported Applications Matrix NexFusion pairs with the official **NexFusion Unified Patches** bundle (`a092devs/Nexfusion-Patches`) to enhance **17+ supported application targets**:
🎥 Video, Audio & Streaming (4 Targets) — YouTube, YouTube Music, Crunchyroll, Stremio
| Application | Package Identifier | Key Patch Capabilities | |---|---|---| | **YouTube** | `com.google.android.youtube` | Ad-free playback, SponsorBlock, background audio, DeArrow replacement, custom speed/quality dialogs, swipe volume/brightness, miniplayer, ambient mode, Litho node bypass, channel search fix. | | **YouTube Music** | `com.google.android.apps.youtube.music` | Background playback, audio ad removal, exclusive audio stream playback, hide upgrade buttons, suppress promotional banners, SoundProof AI blocker, Playlist tags, offline fullscreen player, mark downloaded songs, third-party lyrics enhancement. | | **Crunchyroll** | `com.crunchyroll.crunchyroid` | Native Picture-in-Picture mode with contextual Skip Intro and Skip Credits controls; remove titles from Continue Watching feed. | | **Stremio** | `com.stremio.one` | Auto & manual intro/credits skipping using embedded chapters and stream metadata; auto-pick best stream; hide episode spoilers (synopses & thumbnails); avoid SDH subtitles; audio & subtitle track language memory; smoother playback buffer expansion; seamless binge watching; external player progress & subtitle hand-off. |
💬 Social Networks & Messaging (5 Targets) — Instagram, X (Twitter), Reddit, Discord, LinkedIn
| Application | Package Identifier | Key Patch Capabilities | |---|---|---| | **Instagram** | `com.instagram.android` | Media downloader for feed posts, Reels, Stories, Highlights, and profile pictures; remove sponsored feed posts, Reels, and Story ads; anonymous Story and Live viewing; anonymous DM viewing & disappearing media viewing; strip tracking parameters; remove build expired lockout; hide Meta AI. | | **X (Twitter)** | `com.twitter.android` | Promoted post and ad removal; video and GIF media downloader; bypass Compose sensitive media blur interstitials without tap-to-reveal; block forced updates; telemetry blackholing. | | **Reddit** | `com.reddit.frontpage` | Feed and comment ad removal; guest browsing mode; sanitize shared URLs; suppress screenshot sharing bottom sheet; unmute Redgifs streams; custom feed sorting. | | **Discord** | `com.discord` | Suppress crash telemetry, analytics, touch logging, and advertising identifiers; native system font typography support across chat and UI surfaces. | | **LinkedIn** | `com.linkedin.android` | 1-tap media downloader for photos, carousel images, and progressive MP4 videos; sanitize share links; direct URL navigation bypassing redirects; hide suggested posts, promoted jobs, and premium upsells; feed filters; Material You dynamic theme. |
🛠️ System, Productivity & Utilities (7 Targets) — Google Photos, Google Maps, Gboard, Gmail, Google App (Discover), Proton VPN, 1.1.1.1
| Application | Package Identifier | Key Patch Capabilities | |---|---|---| | **Google Photos** | `com.google.android.apps.photos` | Device spoofing for unlimited original-quality Google Photos cloud storage backups; DCIM folder backup control. | | **Google Maps** | `com.google.android.apps.maps` | Sponsored pin and search ad suppression, high refresh rate unlock (90/120 Hz), telemetry blocking, hide AI clutter, AMOLED black theme. | | **Gboard** | `com.google.android.inputmethod.latin` | Rounded keycaps; Google Sans Flex typography & GM3 Expressive styling; proactive post-correction undo controls; Quick & Magic Emoji (Emojify); expanded AI writing tools; spellchecker chips UI; scan text OCR; spacebar cursor trackpad. | | **Gmail** | `com.google.android.gm` | Suppress sponsored promotional and advertising cards in personal inboxes. | | **Google App (Discover)** | `com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox` | Filter sponsored cards, shopping ads, and promotional recommendations in the Discover feed. | | **Proton VPN** | `ch.protonvpn.android` | Suppress upgrade banners and nag dialogs; unlock NetShield UI toggles; disable telemetry and background observability workers. | | **1.1.1.1** | `com.cloudflare.onedotonedotonedotone` | Spoof WARP+ Unlimited account tier in UI, disable telemetry, and optionally bypass SSL certificate pinning. |
1. **Install Module:** Download and install `NexFusion.apk` from the [Releases](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.a092devs.nexfusion/releases) tab or LSPosed Manager. 2. **Enable in LSPosed:** Enable the NexFusion module in your LSPosed framework. 3. **Open NexFusion:** Launch the app. Go to the **Patches** tab and tap **Install** on the *NexFusion Unified Patches* source. 4. **Configure Scope & Hooks:** Return to the **Home** tab to configure options for your installed apps. Grant LSPosed scope when prompted. 5. **Restart Target Apps:** Force-close and reopen target apps for the in-memory hooks to take effect. --- ## Links & Community - **Source Code**: [github.com/a092devs/NexFusion](https://github.com/a092devs/NexFusion) - **Patch Bundles**: [github.com/a092devs/Nexfusion-Patches](https://github.com/a092devs/Nexfusion-Patches) - **Bug Reports & Feature Requests**: [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/a092devs/NexFusion/issues)

# NexFusion **NexFusion** 是一个开源运行时补丁管理器和 LSPosed 框架，具有干净的 Material You 界面。它使用 **libxposed** 和 **DexKit** 动态地将内存中字节码挂钩应用于流行的 Android 应用程序，而无需修改原始 APK、破坏 Play 商店签名或丢失官方更新路径。 --- ## NexFusion 有何不同？ 与需要编译和重新打包修改后的 APK 的传统修补工具不同： - **零 APK 重新打包**：在应用程序启动时通过 LSPosed 纯粹修改 RAM 中的字节码。原始应用程序保持不变，可以通过 Google Play 正常更新。 - **模块化补丁包（`.nxb`）**：补丁和挂钩作为轻量级、可独立更新的包分发。更新补丁功能，无需重新安装管理器应用程序。 - **动态目标发现**：仅定位已安装的补丁包支持的应用程序 - 没有硬编码的应用程序混乱。 - **自动后台更新**：可选择在后台检查并安装补丁包更新，以获得无缝的“一劳永逸”体验。 - **内置 Stealth Cloak**：屏蔽目标应用程序检测 root 或 Xposed 模块的存在。 --- ## 支持的应用程序矩阵 NexFusion 与官方 **NexFusion Unified Patches** 捆绑包 (`a092devs/Nexfusion-Patches`) 配合使用，以增强 **17+ 支持的应用程序目标**： <详情> 🎥 视频、音频和流媒体（4 个目标） — YouTube、YouTube Music、Crunchyroll、Stremio
|应用 |包裹标识符 |关键补丁功能| |---|---|---| | **YouTube** | `com.google.android.youtube` |无广告播放、SponsorBlock、背景音频、DeArrow 替换、自定义速度/质量对话框、滑动音量/亮度、迷你播放器、环境模式、Litho 节点旁路、频道搜索修复。 | | **YouTube 音乐** | `com.google.android.apps.youtube.music` |后台播放、音频广告去除、独享音频流播放、隐藏升级按钮、抑制促销横幅、SoundProof AI拦截器、播放列表标签、离线全屏播放、标记下载歌曲、第三方歌词增强。 | | **脆脆卷** | `com.crunchyroll.crunchyroid` |原生画中画模式，具有上下文跳过介绍和跳过片尾控件；从“继续观看”源中删除标题。 | | **斯特雷米奥** | `com.stremio.one` |使用嵌入章节和流元数据自动和手动跳过介绍/片尾字幕；自动选择最佳流；隐藏剧集剧透（概要和缩略图）；避免使用 SDH 字幕；音频和字幕轨道语言记忆；播放缓冲扩展更流畅；无缝狂欢观看；外部玩家进度和字幕切换。 | <详情> 💬 社交网络和消息传递（5 个目标） — Instagram、X (Twitter)、Reddit、Discord、LinkedIn
|应用 |包裹标识符|关键补丁功能| |---|---|---| | **Instagram** | `com.instagram.android` |用于提要帖子、卷轴、故事、亮点和个人资料图片的媒体下载器；删除赞助的提要帖子、卷轴和故事广告；匿名故事和现场观看；匿名 DM 观看和消失媒体观看；带材跟踪参数；删除构建过期锁定；隐藏元人工智能。 | | **X（推特）** | `com.twitter.android` |推广帖子和广告删除；视频和 GIF 媒体下载器；绕过撰写敏感媒体模糊插页式广告，无需点击即可显示；阻止强制更新；遥测黑洞。 | | **Reddit** | `com.reddit.frontpage` |删除提要和评论广告；访客浏览模式；清理共享 URL；禁止屏幕截图共享底页；取消静音 Redgifs 流；自定义提要排序。 | | **不和谐** | `com.discord` |抑制崩溃遥测、分析、触摸记录和广告标识符；跨聊天和 UI 界面的本机系统字体排版支持。 | | **领英** | `com.linkedin.android` |用于照片、轮播图像和渐进式 MP4 视频的一键式媒体下载器；卫生调整分享链接；绕过重定向的直接 URL 导航；隐藏建议的帖子、晋升的职位和高级追加销售；进料过滤器； Material You 动态主题。 | <详情> 🛠️ 系统、生产力和实用程序（7 个目标） — Google 相册、Google 地图、Gboard、Gmail、Google App（Discover）、Proton VPN、1.1.1.1
|应用 |包裹标识符|关键补丁功能| |---|---|---| | **谷歌照片** | `com.google.android.apps.photos` |设备欺骗可实现无限制的原始质量 Google Photos 云存储备份； DCIM文件夹备份控制。 | | **谷歌地图** | `com.google.android.apps.maps` |赞助商 pin 和搜索广告抑制、高刷新率解锁 (90/120 Hz)、遥测屏蔽、隐藏 AI 混乱、AMOLED 黑色主题。 | | **Gboard** | `com.google.android.inputmethod.latin` |圆形键帽； Google Sans Flex 排版和 GM3 富有表现力的样式；主动的纠正后撤消控制；快速魔法表情符号（Emojify）；扩展了人工智能写作工具；拼写检查芯片用户界面；扫描文本OCR；空格键光标触控板。 | | **Gmail** | `com.google.android.gm` |禁止在个人收件箱中显示赞助促销卡和广告卡。 | | **Google 应用程序（发现）** | `com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox` |过滤“发现”提要中的赞助卡、购物广告和促销推荐。 | | **质子 VPN** | `ch.protonvpn.android` |抑制升级横幅和唠叨对话框；解锁 NetShield UI 切换；禁用遥测和后台可观测性工作人员。 | | **1.1.1.1** | `com.cloudflare.onedotonedotonedotone` |在 UI 中欺骗 WARP+ Unlimited 帐户层，禁用遥测，并可选择绕过 SSL 证书固定。 | 1. **安装模块：** 从 [Releases](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.a092devs.nexfusion/releases) 选项卡或 LSPod Manager 下载并安装 `NexFusion.apk`。 2. **在 LSPosed 中启用：** 在 LSPosed 框架中启用 NexFusion 模块。 3. **打开 NexFusion：** 启动应用程序。转到 **补丁** 选项卡，然后点击 *NexFusion Unified Patches* 源上的 **安装**。 4. **配置范围和挂钩：** 返回到 **主页** 选项卡以配置已安装应用程序的选项。出现提示时授予 LSPod 范围。 5. **重新启动目标应用程序：** 强制关闭并重新打开目标应用程序以使内存中挂钩生效。 --- ## 链接和社区 - **源代码**：[github.com/a092devs/NexFusion](https://github.com/a092devs/NexFusion) - **补丁包**：[github.com/a092devs/Nexfusion-Patches](https://github.com/a092devs/Nexfusion-Patches) - **错误报告和功能请求**：[GitHub 问题](https://github.com/a092devs/NexFusion/issues)
